arguments.content:
"""
Analysis: percentage of miRNAs significantly differentially expressed
between patient and control groups before multiple testing correction.

Data: Ct values for 175 miRNAs measured in 10 DM1 patients (P_1..P_10)
and 10 healthy controls (C_11..C_20). Source: pone.0150501.s002.xls
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

# Load data
df = pd.read_excel('pone.0150501.s002.xls', sheet_name='RAW DATA', header=1)
df = df.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'miRNA'})
print('Raw shape:', df.shape)
print(df.head())

# Identify groups
patient_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('P_')]
control_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('C_')]
print('\nPatient cols:', patient_cols)
print('Control cols:', control_cols)

# Coerce to numeric (file contains 'NAN' as string in some cells)
for c in patient_cols + control_cols:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')

print('\nMissing values per column:')
print(df[patient_cols + control_cols].isna().sum())

# Per-row counts of valid values per group
df['n_P'] = df[patient_cols].notna().sum(axis=1)
df['n_C'] = df[control_cols].notna().sum(axis=1)
print('\nDistribution of valid counts (P, C):')
print(df[['n_P', 'n_C']].describe())
